AND t.temp_security_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tempSecurityCode}, '%')
AND t.temp_security_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tempSecurityName}, '%')
AND t.status IN
#{item}
AND t.oprt_source IN
#{item}
ORDER BY CASE t.status WHEN 'temporary' THEN 1 WHEN 'updated' THEN 2 WHEN 'cancelled' THEN 3 WHEN 'deleted' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END ASC ,t.update_time DESC ,t.crte_time DESC ,t.id DESC

SELECT id ,sec_id ,temp_security_name ,temp_security_code ,temp_security_market ,temp_security_type ,temp_mitigation_code ,temp_company_code ,temp_company_name_snapshot ,temp_issue_date ,temp_maturity_date ,security_name ,security_code ,security_market ,security_type ,update_time ,status ,is_deleted ,oprt_source ,memo ,crte_time ,updt_time FROM rrs_temp_security_code WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT t.id ,t.temp_security_name ,t.temp_security_code ,t.temp_security_market ,t.temp_security_type ,dst_temp.security_type_name AS tempSecurityTypeName ,t.temp_mitigation_code ,t.temp_company_code ,t.temp_company_name_snapshot ,t.temp_issue_date ,t.temp_maturity_date ,t.security_name ,t.security_code ,t.security_market ,t.security_type ,dst.security_type_name ,t.update_time ,t.status ,t.oprt_source ,t.memo ,t.crte_time ,t.updt_time FROM rrs_temp_security_code t LEFT JOIN dict_security_type dst_temp ON dst_temp.security_type = t.temp_security_type AND dst_temp.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = t.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.is_deleted = 0

SELECT id ,temp_security_code ,temp_security_name ,security_code FROM rrs_temp_security_code WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'temporary' AND security_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(security_code) != '' ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM rrs_temp_security_code WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'temporary' AND temp_security_code = #{securityCode}

SELECT c.s_info_compcode AS companyCode ,MAX(c.s_info_compname) AS fullName ,MAX(c.s_info_compname) AS shortName FROM ais_inv_ods.wind_cbondissuer c
AND c.s_info_compcode IS NOT NULL AND c.s_info_compcode != ''
AND (c.s_info_compname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{companyKeyword}, '%') OR c.s_info_compcode LIKE CONCAT('%', #{companyKeyword}, '%'))
AND c.s_info_compcode = #{tempCompanyCode}
GROUP BY c.s_info_compcode LIMIT 50
SELECT c.s_info_compcode AS companyCode ,c.s_info_compname AS fullName ,c.s_info_compname AS shortName FROM ais_inv_ods.wind_cbondissuer c WHERE c.s_info_compcode = #{companyCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT si.wind_code AS securityCode ,COALESCE(NULLIF(si.short_name, ''), si.full_name, si.wind_code) AS securityName ,si.security_type ,dst.security_type_name FROM rrs_securityinfo si LEFT JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = si.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0
AND si.security_status != 'D' AND si.security_source != 'temporary' AND si.security_type NOT IN ('crmw', 'company')
AND (si.wind_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{securityKeyword}, '%') OR si.short_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{securityKeyword}, '%') OR si.full_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{securityKeyword}, '%'))
AND si.wind_code = #{securityCode}
ORDER BY si.ts DESC ,si.wind_code DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT si.wind_code AS securityCode ,COALESCE(NULLIF(si.short_name, ''), si.full_name, si.wind_code) AS securityName ,si.security_type ,dst.security_type_name FROM rrs_securityinfo si LEFT JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = si.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0 WHERE si.wind_code = #{securityCode} AND si.security_status != 'D' AND si.security_source != 'temporary' AND si.security_type NOT IN ('crmw', 'company') LIMIT 1

SELECT security_type ,security_type_name ,category_type ,category_type_name FROM dict_security_type WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND category_type != 'company' ORDER BY category_type ASC ,sort_order ASC ,id ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dict_security_type WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND security_type = #{securityType}
